html:
Atlanta Framing Contractor Services

Build Heritage is a Georgia contractor that does framing for homes in Atlanta and the surrounding metro area. You can get a free, written and itemized quote and hear back within one business day.

How the process works

  1. Complete the quote form on the Itemized Contractor Quote – Atlanta page or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. A Georgia‑licensed and insured contractor reviews your details and replies within one business day with a written estimate.
  3. You approve the estimate and schedule the work.
  4. The framing work is performed on the agreed schedule.

What you receive

  • A free, written and itemized quote.
  • A Georgia‑licensed and insured contractor will do the work.
  • If you need other services, you can access our eight trades: packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.
  • The 2026 cost guide gives ranges: a full roof replacement is $9,000‑$20,000 and a whole‑home interior repaint is $3,000‑$8,000.
  • The cost guide recommends holding back 10‑15 % of the quoted amount for hidden issues.

FAQ

How long does it take to receive a quote? You will receive a written, itemized estimate within one business day of submitting the form or emailing us.

Are you licensed and insured in Georgia? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in the state of Georgia.

What if hidden problems appear during framing? The cost guide advises setting aside 10‑15 % of the quoted amount to cover any unforeseen issues that may arise.

Next step

Ready to start your framing project? Request your free quote now.
